response.sql:
WITH media_type_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM media_type_metrics
), kept AS (
  SELECT m.avg_unit_price, m.bytes_per_millisecond, b.avg_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM media_type_metrics AS m
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE m.bytes_per_millisecond > b.avg_bytes_per_millisecond
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_kept_media_type_unit_price,
  AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_kept_bytes_per_millisecond,
  AVG(bytes_per_millisecond - avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_excess_bytes_per_millisecond
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: A media type's bytes-per-millisecond figure is the simple average of each track's Bytes divided by Milliseconds; tracks with missing Bytes are ignored by AVG. Division is forced to floating point, and a zero-millisecond track contributes NULL under SQLite semantics.
